name: DUMBBELL STEP-UP ONTO CHAIR
introduce:
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Stand in front of a chair. 

Then step up on the chair and step back down. 

The exercise works to strengthen the legs and buttocks.

tips.text: Make sure your whole foot is on the chair.
Exhale when you step up, and inhale when you step down.
If you feel it's too hard, use a lower chair.
This exercise is good for your legs and gluteus.
This exercise will help you get good balance.
